desc: Implement duplicate-safe sliding-median structure with lazy deletion and maintained sums for all length-\(x\) window costs.
Correct the cardinality-constrained DP to enforce exactly \(j\) non-overlapping windows.
Fix initial-window heap rebalancing when fewer than `target_low` elements have been inserted.
Verify examples and targeted edge cases, including \(x=n\), \(k=1\), adjacent windows, negative values, duplicates, and already-equal windows.
Combine and present the corrected complete `Solution.minOperations` implementation.
